model_annotation: Figure 4 is a line plot illustrating the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on the BioMedLM model, where “Base” denotes the LLM without editing. The x-axis, labeled “Co-occurrence Number,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at intervals of 10⁰, 10², and 10³. The y-axis, labeled “ACC (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 65 percent. The plot contains four lines, each representing a different editing method: “Base” (blue solid line with circle markers), “FT” (red dashed line with triangle markers), “MEND” (green solid line with square markers), and “IKE” (purple solid line with diamond markers). The “Base” line starts at approximately 32.5% and ends at approximately 40.3%. The “FT” line starts at approximately 33.5% and ends at approximately 40.7%. The “MEND” line starts at approximately 91.3% and ends at approximately 40.3%. The “IKE” line starts at approximately 83.8% and ends at approximately 96.8%. All lines show a general trend of declining accuracy as the co-occurrence number increases, with the “IKE” line showing the highest accuracy across the entire range.
